'''Nath Goordi''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Nath Goordi system/Legends|Nath Goordi system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that was home to a procession of [[Nath Goordian heirs|royal heirs]].

==History==
Sometime prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Seek Ryontarr]] was tasked with finding and rescuing the heirs. He eventually completed his task, although the heirs never returned home, and the planet entered a war over who would succeed the heirs. Also, Ryontarr never returned to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], instead becoming a member of the [[Mind Walkers]] at [[Sinkhole Station]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]].
